initial_reasons.BEN: Ben tries to contain his pride and watches Ari carefully, aware that the news may be difficult for her.
initial_reasons.ARI: Ari maintains a professional expression and steady attention, masking her disappointment.

BEN.reason: Asking whether they are okay reveals Ben's concern about the effect of the promotion on their relationship.

ARI.reason: Hearing that Ben received the position briefly unsettles Ari beneath her professional mask.
Ari quickly restores her polite composure and reassures Ben despite the disappointment she is concealing.
Ari offers the congratulations with controlled professionalism, keeping the underlying hurt contained.
